args.query: Bun.serve websocket server with pub/sub topics

results.title: ws WebSocket server with a Zod-validated message protocol
results.summary: A room chat server on the ws library with token auth on the upgrade URL, a Zod 4 discriminated union for every inbound frame and typed error replies, tested offline with real ws clients on an ephemeral localhost port.

results.title: Next.js 16 server actions + Zod with useActionState-shaped results
results.summary: A 'use server' form action that validates FormData with Zod and returns field errors in the shape useActionState expects, tested by calling the action directly.

results.title: FastAPI WebSockets with token auth and broadcast, tested with TestClient
results.summary: FastAPI WebSocket endpoint that authenticates via query token, rejects with a close code and broadcasts to connected clients; tested with TestClient.websocket_connect.

results.title: Apollo Server 5 resolvers with per-request DataLoader batching
results.summary: An Apollo Server 5 schema whose nested resolvers use per-request DataLoader instances to batch and dedupe lookups (no N+1), with GraphQLError extension codes and cache invalidation after a mutation, tested in-process with executeOperation.

results.title: tRPC 11 client + server over fetch with superjson (Vitest)
results.summary: End-to-end typed tRPC 11: fetch adapter server, createTRPCClient with httpBatchLink and superjson transformer for Dates and Maps, tested in-process with Vitest.

results.title: Vue 3 SSR with renderToString
results.summary: Server-render a Vue 3 app built with defineComponent and h(), covering props, computed, list rendering and provide/inject, then assert the HTML output offline.

results.title: Flask API args parsed and validated with webargs and marshmallow
results.summary: Flask routes that parse query strings and JSON bodies through marshmallow schemas via webargs, with JSON 422 validation errors, tested offline with the Flask test client.

results.title: hapi server with joi validation
results.summary: Build a @hapi/hapi server with joi-validated params, payload and query, a custom failAction and Boom errors, tested via server.inject offline.

results.title: aiohttp routes tested offline with the pytest-aiohttp test client
results.summary: An aiohttp JSON app exercised through the pytest-aiohttp in-process test client, plus a conftest that brings loopback up so the client runs inside a network-isolated sandbox.

results.title: tRPC 11 + Zod router with server-side caller
results.summary: A typed tRPC router with Zod inputs, an auth middleware, and tests through createCaller.
